title: This CSV Looks Clean. It Isn't. #excel #automation #shorts
description: A clean-looking CSV can still hide whitespace, casing, header and duplicate problems. This animated workflow shows how to flag issues, validate the cleanup, review the changes and export safely. #excel #csv #automation #datacleaning

captions.text: That spreadsheet looks clean. It isn't.
AI can catch the problems you usually miss.
Don't let it silently delete anything.
Review the flagged rows, then export.
Faster cleanup — and cleanup you can verify.
